analysis.half_plane_comparator: Both nonzero half-planes have angular span strictly less than pi, so positive cross product defines strict weak ordering within each partition. Opposite directions are in different partitions.
analysis.zero_equivalence: Zero is removed from the cross-only comparator to avoid treating it as equivalent to all nonzero directions. Ascending puts zero before both halves; descending puts zero after both halves.
analysis.iterator_ranges: Ascending: begin<=zero_end<=middle<=end. Descending: begin<=middle<=zero_end<=end. Both sorted ranges are valid.
analysis.range_detection: The OR of unsigned coordinate plus 2^31 fits uint32 exactly iff every signed coordinate lies in [-2^31,2^31-1]. Aggregation occurs during the required half-plane partition.
analysis.small_products: A product of two signed 32-bit values fits int64; code compares products without subtracting.
analysis.wide_products: Products of two int64 values fit signed 128-bit. Code compares products without computing potentially overflowing determinant difference. Standard fallback remains exact two-limb multiplication.
analysis.small_input: n<32 retains prior comparator path. n=31,32,33 explicitly covered.
analysis.api_compatibility: All existing public signatures and constexpr comparison functions remain unchanged; sort ties remain unspecified.
analysis.helper: Large path has independent REINSIRK_ANGLE_SORT_LARGE_DEFINED guard. GCC/Clang noinline is conditional; standard compiler path omits attribute. New public wrapper calls the same large algorithm.

sort_only_benchmark.conditions: C++23 -O2; CPU14; shared benchmark.lock; old/candidate2/direct wrappers/candidate1 rotating five methods over seven repetitions; median of seven; copy excluded; local sortedness checked.
